name: Marketplace+
description: Improve Seanime's Extensions marketplace with live status badges (Working/Broken/Deprecated), star counts, sorting by most stars or recent updates, author search, sub/dub tags, and per-extension Discord support buttons.
author: bas1874
notes: Add the custom marketplace URL in Settings → Extensions → Marketplace Sources, then open the Extensions page — badges, filters, sorting, and Support buttons appear directly on the marketplace cards. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bas1874/Seanime-Marketplace/refs/heads/main/Marketplace/Main.json

networkAccess.reasoning: Required to fetch extension metadata from the custom Seanime marketplace hosted on GitHub.
